facts.text: Launched on December 15, 1995 out of research at Digital Equipment Corporation.
Stunned the mid-90s web with full-text search over what was then an enormous index, reported in the tens of millions of pages.
Passed through a chain of owners, including Compaq and Overture, before ending up under Yahoo!.
Yahoo! shut AltaVista down on July 8, 2013.
